'''Crovendif''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[drug dealer]] who worked for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Black Sun sector chief|Sector Chief]] [[Avrak Villachor]] in [[Iltarr City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Crovendif was approached by the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Dayja/Legends|Dayja]], who was posing as a street criminal as part of a ploy to steal Black Sun's blackmail files, and the agent convinced Crovendif that he had access to a new source of [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] and wanted to make a deal with Villachor. Crovendif later encountered Dayja once more several days later and he escorted Dayja at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]] to meet with Villachor.<ref name="Scoundrels" />
